posts.text: A study of the environmental history of Yellowstone National Park over the past 15,000 years suggests that climate warming is likely to reduce hydrothermal activity and increase wildfire activity—but will likely not change the dominance of lodgepole pine. posts.external_title: Synthesis of pyrroles from isoxazoles by an O-to-C skeletal edit - Nature
posts.external_description: A one-pot skeletal-editing reaction replaces isoxazole oxygen with carbon to form challenging pyrroles, enabled by an N-propargylic enaminone intermediate and a computational model predicting reaction outcomes.
